day_shape: 59 items: Khamenei week-long state funeral opens in Tehran with Die Welt citing classified projection of up to 3,000 deaths, UK-France-Oman joint statement on Strait of Hormuz transit, IDF strikes ~10 Hezbollah sites in southern Lebanon.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral opens in Tehran
threads.summary: Iran began the first day of a week-long state funeral for Ali Khamenei at Imam Khomeini Prayer Ground, with IRIB and Defa Press running continuous coverage of crowds, poetry recitations and clergy. Jerusalem Post reported chants of 'Death to America' and 'Revenge' in Tehran, while Iran International cited a Die Welt report of a classified document projecting 1,500–3,000 deaths across ceremonies.

threads.label: Vengeance rhetoric from IRGC and MOIS
threads.summary: Iran's Ministry of Intelligence issued a statement pledging to 'avenge the blood of the martyred Leader,' and IRGC Navy commander Alireza Azemmayee said 'divine vengeance' against the US and Israel was 'not far off.' Defa Press also carried remarks from Army Navy deputy commander Admiral Bamani and Brigadier General Asadi linking military posture to Khamenei's legacy.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz: UK-France-Oman deal
threads.summary: Downing Street published a joint Starmer–Macron statement announcing an agreement with Oman to work together on safe transit through the Strait of Hormuz. Iran's Foreign Ministry deputy Kazem Gharibabadi warned of 'consequences' for military adventurism, Iranian hardliners accused negotiators of ceding authority to a US-backed Omani route, and Speaker Ghalibaf confirmed an Iran-Oman traffic arrangement under Article V of the US MoU.

threads.label: IDF strikes and Lebanon framework
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck around 10 Hezbollah infrastructure sites in Bint Jbeil, Beit Yahoun, Kounine and Baraashit in southern Lebanon and hit a weapons-transporting cell near the buffer zone. Israeli Ambassador Yechiel Leiter said the Israel-Lebanon framework depends on ground conditions rather than a fixed withdrawal timetable, and IDF Arabic spokesperson Avichay Adraee posted about 60 coffins in Mashhad.

threads.label: Iran domestic repression and diaspora
threads.summary: Iran International reported five more protesters sentenced to death in central Iran on 'enmity against God' charges and political prisoner Mehdi Nazer and his fiancée sentenced to death on Israel-linked charges. A London court sentenced two Romanian nationals to a combined 20 years for the 2024 stabbing of Iran International journalist Pouria Zeraati, while Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi called for diaspora protests outside US embassies.

events.summary_en: Glorious return of the Strait of Hormuz defender martyr to the embrace of homeland. The pure body of the honourable martyr Hossein Sotoudeh, diver and defender of the territorial waters and strategic Strait of Hormuz, has returned to the homeland after 32 days of search in the Oman Sea. This honourable martyr, on 4 Khordad, along with his fellow martyrs Ghadratolah Zargarizade, Abbas Islami, and Abdolreza Golzari, was targeted in a missile attack by the American enemy while on a monitoring and surveillance mission in the Strait of Hormuz and achieved martyrdom. The funeral and burial ceremony of this valiant martyr will be held on Monday, 15 Tir, with the presence of the people of Zabol.

events.summary_en: Gharibabadi warns: Any military adventurism in the Strait of Hormuz will have consequences. Kazem Gharibabadi, Deputy for Legal and International Affairs at the Foreign Ministry, in response to statements by France and Britain regarding the Strait of Hormuz, wrote on social media X: The Strait of Hormuz is not a stage for military displays by extra-regional powers. Hormuz's security belongs to the coastal states; those who create crises will be responsible for the consequences of their adventurism; this warning is serious.

events.title_en: Admiral Bamani: Exposing the true face of criminal America in the exhibition of the martyrs of the destroyer 'Dena' / the Navy is more prepared than ever. The Deputy Commander of the Army Navy, in an interview with Defense Press, cited the purpose of holding the exhibition of the works of the martyrs of the destroyer Dena as honouring the blood of the martyrs, increasing the motivation of personnel, and exposing America's crimes in attacking a ship on a peaceful mission.
events.summary_en: Admiral Bamani: Exposing the true face of criminal America in the exhibition of the martyrs of the destroyer 'Dena' / the Navy is more prepared than ever. The Deputy Commander of the Army Navy, in an interview with Defense Press, cited the purpose of holding the exhibition of the works of the martyrs of the destroyer Dena as honouring the blood of the martyrs, increasing the motivation of personnel, and exposing America's crimes in attacking a ship on a peaceful mission. We have also placed this exhibition in heavily frequented public places such as airports so that everyone knows what crimes lie behind America's apparent humanitarian and peace-seeking facade. Today, with lessons learned from the 12-day imposed war and the Ramadan War, we are far more prepared than in the past, and the enemy will certainly be aware of this fact.

events.title_en: Brigadier General Asadi: The successes of the Armed Forces are due to the measures of the martyred Leader of the Revolution. The former Deputy Inspector of the Central Headquarters of Khatam al-Anbiya (Peace Be Upon Him), in an interview with Defense Press, said:
events.summary_en: Brigadier General Asadi: The successes of the Armed Forces are due to the measures of the martyred Leader of the Revolution. The former Deputy Inspector of the Central Headquarters of Khatam al-Anbiya (Peace Be Upon Him), in an interview with Defense Press, said: In the past year, whether in the 12-day imposed war or in the Ramadan War, we witnessed how well things proceeded. The reason for this success was the wise measures of our martyred Imam and his support for all branches of the Armed Forces. Thank God, today our military power and especially our popular backing is unparalleled, and the Iranian nation cannot be compared to anywhere in the world. Today the field and the streets are complementary to each other. Over the past year, many elite youth from across the country have presented excellent plans for progress.
